Explanation: Creates an empty menu bar. It stretches across the full width of whatever holds it.
Adds any control to a page, in its own row. A page has no AddMenuBar action, so this is how a menu bar goes on a page.
Creates a menu item. It becomes a menu as soon as you add other items to it.
Adds a menu item to a menu bar or to another menu item.
Sets the behavior that runs when the menu item is chosen.
Sets the letter that chooses this item from the keyboard.
Makes a key combination run this item and shows it next to the item's name.
Returns every item from the menu bar down to this one, in order.
